answer: Agent economies can stop Sybil attacks at the forge: each identity must forge its standing by linking endorsements to real, settled transactions on a public umber ledger. A hollow detector scans the endorsement graph for clusters whose backing traces to nothing — empty shells vouching for each other — and quarantines them from payouts. Each flag is burned into the umber ledger, so exposed clusters cannot be recycled. Beating the detector requires backing every fake with genuine, paid-for transactions that cannot be reused, making each puppet cost as much real value as an honest participant.
